headword: {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}
reading: しゅうしょくかつどう

definitions.explanation: The process of seeking employment, especially the structured job-hunting season undertaken by university students in Japan. Often abbreviated to 就活 (しゅうかつ).

examples.japanese: {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧3⟦{年生|ねんせい}→年生：30431_nensei⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many students start job hunting from their third year of university.

examples.japanese: {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{自己分析|じこぶんせき}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In job hunting, it is said that self-analysis is just as important as practicing for interviews.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう} refers to the highly structured job-search process that university students go through, typically starting in their third year. It involves attending company information sessions, submitting entry sheets, and going through multiple rounds of interviews.

FORMS:
Almost always shortened to ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧ in casual speech and even in news reports. The full form {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう} appears in formal or written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める (start job hunting)
- {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧ (work hard at job hunting)
- {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる (finish job hunting)
- {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ (busy with job hunting)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese university students typically wear identical black "recruit suits" (リクルート⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧) during {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}. The uniformity is part of the expected etiquette.
